h:
这是一个超级基本的工作流程，最多包含五个 Nano Banana 模型的参考图像。它使用官方 ComfyUI Nano Banana 节点。确保更新到最新的 ComfyUI 版本，如果这不起作用，请改用夜间构建。请注意，您需要 API 积分才能使用它，可以通过您的 Comfy 帐户购买。

下载内容包括我在示例中使用的两张测试图像：来自我一贯角色 LoRA 的美丽女子（https://civitai.com/models/1750662/photorealistic-ai-influencer-woman877-character-lora-sd15-or-sdxl-or-flux）和一件毛衣，因此您可以在输出中看到 Nano Banana 如何将毛衣应用到她身上。

o.en:
This is a super basic workflow with up to five reference images for the Nano Banana model. It uses the official ComfyUI Nano Banana node. Make sure you update to the latest ComfyUI version, and if that does not work, use the nightly build instead. Please note that you need API credits to use it, which can be purchased through your Comfy account.

The download includes the two test images I used in the example: the beautiful woman from my consistent character LoRA (https://civitai.com/models/1750662/photorealistic-ai-influencer-woman877-character-lora-sd15-or-sdxl-or-flux) and a sweater, so you can see how Nano Banana applies the sweater to her in the output.
